info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Fitness Memberships Status API provides real-time insights into the various statuses of fitness memberships. This endpoint allows users to retrieve information regarding active, expired, or pending memberships, enabling gyms and fitness organizations to manage their customer memberships effectively. Typical consumers include gym administrators and fitness center managers who need to monitor membership statuses for operational decisions. By leveraging this API, users can ensure timely communication with members and enhance overall membership management.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of memberships.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of memberships for users. It returns relevant membership information such as active, inactive, or pending statuses, helping you understand the current state of a user's membership.

requestBody.description: This request is used to retrieve the current status of memberships. The request body must conform to the specified JSON schema to ensure proper handling of the request.

ListFitnessMembershipsStatusRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation on memberships status. This is expected to be a string representation of the requested memberships status.
